name: ads-bridge
tagline: Local MCP server for driving Revit from chat using pyRevit ADS_Bridge.
description: Drive Revit directly from chat with a local MCP server exposing the pyRevit ADS_Bridge HTTP API. Supports various tools like querying, executing IronPython scripts, setting parameters, running pipelines, and taking screenshots.

page.objective: Local MCP server for driving Revit from chat using pyRevit ADS_Bridge.
page.solution: Drive Revit directly from chat with a local MCP server exposing the pyRevit ADS_Bridge HTTP API. Supports various tools like querying, executing IronPython scripts, setting parameters, running pipelines, and taking screenshots.

highlights.headline: Seven MCP tools drive a live Revit model from Claude chat.
points: Query the model, run IronPython, set parameters, run pipelines, take screenshots.
Runtime copy lives at a stable local path so Z-drive drops don't break it.
FastMCP server (server.py) talks to the pyRevit ADS_Bridge HTTP API.
